title: Utility Services Terms: Billed Occupants and Lease Modifications
content:
# Billed Occupants — Utility Services Program

**Term.** The billed occupants of a utility account change only when the lease's approved occupants count changes through a signed lease modification, and the new count applies from the next billing period. A resident's statement that someone moved out without a signed modification never changes it. A change is never applied to a period already billed except through an occupancy correction when the billed figure was not the one in force.

## Authority and timing

- **Authority:** the lease record — its approved occupants count as changed by a signed lease modification. A resident's statement is not a basis for a change.
- **Object:** the lease the utility account serves.
- **Timing:** the new count applies from the next billing period, never to a period already billed; a period billed on a figure other than the one in force is set right only through an occupancy correction.

## Situations and outcomes

| Situation | Billed occupants |
|---|---|
| A signed lease modification changes the approved occupants count | the new count applies from the next billing period |
| A resident says an occupant moved out, and no signed modification exists | unchanged |
| A period was billed on the count then in force | not re-billed for a later change |
| A period was billed on a count other than the one in force for it | set right only through an occupancy correction |

*Example (hypothetical dates):* a signed lease modification in mid-April reduces the approved occupants from 3 to 2. The Utility Services Program account bills 3 occupants for April and 2 from May, the next billing period.
